films.title: LSD: Let's Skate Dude
films.description: Krooked Skateboards' 2017 full-length mixes six complete parts with team travel montages from Barcelona, New York City, Santa Monica and San Francisco. Filmed and edited by Tim Fulton, it features Mark Gonzales, Mike Anderson, Brad Cromer, Bobby Worrest, Dan Drehobl, Sebo Walker, Ronnie Sandoval and Matt Gottwig.

Independent review confirms that Tim Fulton filmed and edited the full-length, that it debuted on Krooked's YouTube channel, and that it contains six full parts and four team travel montages.
